## Purpose

Each mathematical note is stored in its own folder. This keeps the source file, figures, references, and supplementary material together.

## Recommended metadata

A typical note will begin with metadata of the following form:

```yaml
---
title: "Title of the Note"
description: "A concise summary."
date: 2026-07-20
date-modified: 2026-07-20
categories:
  - Large Deviations
  - Gibbs Measures
toc: true
number-sections: true
---
```

## Mathematics

MathJax renders inline mathematics such as \(X_t\) and displayed mathematics such as

$$
I(x)=\sup_{\theta\in\mathbb{R}}
\left\{\theta x-\Lambda(\theta)\right\}.
$$

This guide can be deleted after real notes have been added.
